skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand the development and evolution of economic theories over time.
Grasp the concept of value in goods and its distribution, exchange, and usage.
Analyze the role of the state in economic production and distribution.
Study the foundational principles of classical economic thought.
Examine the theories of John Maynard Keynes and their impact on modern economics.
Explore the principles of neoclassical economic theory.
Understand contemporary political economy theories and their application.
